name: ShrinkIt
description: URL shortener with unique short-code generation and click analytics. Redirects use the cache-aside pattern: Redis first, MongoDB fallback, cached with a TTL.

name: AI Health Tracker
description: Uses Google Gemini to turn plain-text meals and workouts into structured data (calories, macros, duration). Sets personalised daily calorie goals with BMR, and falls back to manual entry if the AI analysis fails.

name: Subscription Management API
description: Backend API that schedules automated email reminders 7, 5, 2, and 1 days before a subscription renews. Secured with JWT, plus Arcjet for bot detection and rate limiting.

name: IdeasAnswer
description: Notes app that answers questions about your saved notes using a locally hosted Llama 3 model. AI responses are cached in Redis to cut repeated model calls.
